Legacy command intent:

ViewBS GlobalMethLev --sample sample.tab,WT --outdir out --prefix global --minDepth 1 --maxDepth 100

Expected output provenance:

The local legacy Perl entrypoint cannot be executed in this environment because Getopt::Long::Subcommand is not installed. This fixture follows the checked-in legacy implementation in lib/Meth/GlobalLev.pm:

- keep records with 1 <= methylated + unmethylated <= 100;
- collect observed contexts in sorted order;
- preserve sample order from --sample;
- use weighted methylation by default;
- format each context value with sprintf("%.3f").
